coverage.note: Partial extracted Bavli coverage; absence is not evidence that no interaction occurred.

records.cueHe: אזל רב גביהה מבי כתיל, אמרה לשמעתא קמיה דרב אשי
records.about: reciting Rava's ruling on purifying temed in Rav Ashi's presence in order to press a question on it

what distinguishes water impure from the outset, given that the reason offered — heavy water settling below while the residue floats above — would equally block purification where the water was pure and later became impure

records.cueHe: אי הכי, טהורים ולבסוף נטמאו נמי
records.about: the settling-and-floating rationale proves too much, since it would equally void contact for water that was pure and later became impure
the true reason contact works is that water and residue are intermingled — which holds in the impure-from-the-outset case as well

records.cueHe: אמר ליה רב גביהה מבי כתיל לרב אשי: איפכא תני תנא קמיה דאביי
records.about: that the tanna recited the reverse before Abaye, and that it was Abaye who corrected it into the version Dostai teaches
